name: Ode Osbourne
event: UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs. Nolan
summary: Long, explosive Jamaican flyweight (13-9, 2 NC; 5-7, 1 NC in the UFC) with real one-punch power (three UFC knockouts) but chronic trouble once he's taken down. 1-3 (1 NC) in his last five; his February decision loss to Alibi Idiris was overturned to a no contest after Idiris tested positive for a diuretic.

how_they_fight.Striking: Sharp, fast counter-puncher with a 185 cm reach (very long for 125). Fight-ending left hand: dropped and finished Luis Gurule in R2 with a counter left, KO'd Jerome Rivera in 26 seconds and Zarrukh Adashev in 61. Low volume (about 2.7 significant strikes a minute) and waits for one big shot; Cageside Press said he got overeager with power shots against Idiris and lost his rhythm.
how_they_fight.Grappling: The hole. Taken down in all three rounds by Idiris (5 of 15), out-controlled by Erceg (nearly 5 minutes, ended in mount and a back-take), Ronaldo Rodriguez (over 9 minutes of control) and Gurule in R1. Four submission losses (Calvo, Kelleher, Almabayev, Filho). Offensive submissions mostly on the regionals.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped six times: four submissions and two knockouts (Kape, Tyson Nam). Hard to hit cleanly at range, but takedown defense is about 61% and he's poor from his back.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Front-loaded. Ten stoppage wins: eight in R1, two in R2 (Lee, Gurule) - none later. Six stoppage losses: five in R1 (Calvo, Kelleher, Kape, Nam, Filho), one in R2 (Almabayev). Decisions: 3-3. Against Erceg he hurt him early (Erceg took a knee) and then lost the later rounds to grappling; vs Idiris he was best in R2 then got taken down again in R3. Danger is highest for both men in the first 7-8 minutes; if it goes late, the grappler usually takes it.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Frustrating by reputation: Sherdog calls him one of the UFC's more frustrating fighters, with top-15 tools but too many losses. Flexible with weight (has fought at 125, 135 and 145) and takes short-notice fights (Erceg).

patterns: Counter left hand: three UFC KOs, two in R1 and Gurule in R2
Loses when wrestled: repeated takedowns and long control in the Rodriguez, Erceg and Idiris fights
All stoppages either way have come in R1-R2
Slow starts in some fights (Idiris put him on a knee early) but dangerous until the fight goes to the mat
concerns: Takedown defense and bottom game against a wrestler like Durden
Age 35 and a July withdrawal through injury (undisclosed)
Submission losses: four, including Filho and Almabayev
keys_to_beat: Shoot early and often; chain takedowns even if the first few fail
Keep him on the fence and in the clinch, away from the counter left
Take his back in scrambles - he gives it up under pressure (Erceg)

news.text: Withdrew from his UFC 329 bout with Cody Durden through an undisclosed injury after an eight-week camp; Alessandro Costa replaced him (Boxing News, citing Sherdog).
Lost a unanimous decision to Alibi Idiris at UFC Houston; the result was later overturned to a no contest after Idiris tested positive for hydrochlorothiazide (our data records NC).
Rebooked against Cody Durden at flyweight for Oct 31.
